change: Install the scalar URL helper only for Window fetch clients. Worker URL and URLSearchParams constructors remain installed. A diagnostic retain flag reproduces the old behavior while keeping the document path unchanged.
scope: Native Send input begins -> first audited assistant text containing Rome; 250 ms observation timers. A native published-layer screenshot follows one second later. Five-second readiness settle and typing are excluded from this submit-to-answer interval.

root_cause_diagnostic.old_behavior: dil-old-behavior.log: Failed to remove sandbox global __ladybirdSerializeURLText; no acknowledgement
root_cause_diagnostic.qualification: Retained pre-fix focused binary executes the original worker module. VOX_RETAIN_HREF_URL_OBJECTS=1 suppresses the scalar helper in this worker-only diagnostic. Actual production comparison uses the narrower worker-only control flag.

headless_smoke.metric: sampled sum of process-tree RSS; shared pages may be counted twice

limitations: Two complete control/fix/Brave triplets are observations, not a large statistical cohort or frozen-response engine acceptance. Live responses and server work vary.
Vox and Brave have different input/observation adapters and their normal filtering policies; the observed ratio is not isolated engine cost.
Host load was elevated (18 CPUs; one-minute load 22.9–29.3 during the matched cohort). Exact load/timestamps are retained.
The earlier baseline and first fixed pilot use different completed executable identities and are not included in the matched medians. A compile ran alongside the fixed pilot.
The first native sample raced process startup and sampled PID 0; it is invalid. The second sample adds instrumentation and supplies diagnostic attribution only.
The first worker diagnostic compile hit its 3 GiB guard. Subsequent compilations use the default 12 GiB guard, with focused runtime execution capped at 3 GiB.

Early regression-test drafts failed when attempting to remove the classic host global Symbol.toStringTag, including one entry-time version without an exposed error. The retained test verifies helper absence/native URLs in both worker types and complete lockdown/port acknowledgement in module workers, as used by this site.
No startup JavaScript reduction or CPU instruction credit is claimed. The previously unshipped 2.66 MB prototype remains separate. This change leaves the frozen startup at 2990874 total bytes.
